source: prototype/luna-farm/src/sim_template.html (SPOT, TOOLS, POSTS, FLOWERS, W/H, C/RX/RY, BARN)
comment: Landmark foot coordinates in world px. A sprite stands on a spot when its foot point equals the spot.

field.comment: Walkable diamond: |x-cx|/rx + |y-cy|/ry < m, with m .9 for targets and .97 for the soft clamp. Not an ellipse.

barn.comment: Solid rectangle nobody walks through; the path router detours below it (y1 + 10, x0 - 12 or x1 + 12).

trough.comment: Water trough. Sheep drink at trough + (16, 4); the farmer tops it up.

hay.comment: Hay bale. Sheep feed at hay + (-20..-8, 10); the farmer refills it.

gate.comment: Inner gate. NPCs pass it on the way in and out.

web.comment: Cobweb corner by the gate. Legacy tool alias `web`; nothing walks here today.

gateOut.comment: Outer gate on the field's edge. NPCs cross the inside/outside line here.

offstage.comment: Off-canvas spawn and despawn point for NPCs (past the right edge).

barnDoor.comment: Barn doorway. Sheep shelter here in rain; DL waits at door + (-34, 4) and sleeps at door + (24, 2).

tree.comment: The tree on the left. Landmark only in v31; no behaviour targets it yet.

front.comment: Front-of-field mark. DL's `come` action walks her here.

aliases.comment: TOOLS map inherited from the agent-era demo; each name resolves to a spot above.

posts.comment: Fence post tops the bird perches on, as [x, y].

flowers.comment: Flower patches; the two butterflies home on the first two, as [x, y].
